<svg viewBox="0 0 520 270" role="img" aria-label="Animal superclass with Dog, Cat and Bird subclasses"><defs><marker id="inheritance-1-tri" viewBox="0 0 12 12" refX="11" refY="6" markerWidth="13" markerHeight="13" orient="auto"><path d="M1 1L11 6L1 11z" class="mk-tri"></path></marker></defs>

      <text x="196" y="70" class="m s t2">name</text>
      <text x="196" y="90" class="m s t2">eat()   speak()</text>

      <path d="M260 176 V108" class="ln" marker-end="url(#inheritance-1-tri)"></path>

      <rect x="185" y="176" width="150" height="84" rx="14" class="f-box"></rect>

      <rect x="360" y="176" width="150" height="84" rx="14" class="f-box"></rect>
      <text x="435" y="200" text-anchor="middle" class="h">Bird</text><text x="374" y="226" class="m s a">speak() → "Tweet"</text><text x="374" y="246" class="m s g">+ fly()</text>
    </svg>

inheritance-2.alt: Constructor chaining: new Dog calls Animal constructor first, then Dog body
inheritance-2.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 520 112" role="img" aria-label="Constructor chaining: new Dog calls Animal constructor first, then Dog body"><defs><marker id="inheritance-2-ar" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" class="mk"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="6" y="14" width="152" height="84" rx="14" class="f-b"></rect>
      <text x="82" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="h b">① you call</text><text x="82" y="64" text-anchor="middle" class="m s">new Dog("Rex")</text>
      <rect x="184" y="14" width="152" height="84" rx="14" class="f-p"></rect>
      <text x="260" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="h p">② Animal(name)</text><text x="260" y="64" text-anchor="middle" class="s t2">via super(name)</text><text x="260" y="82" text-anchor="middle" class="s t2">parent part built FIRST</text>
      <rect x="362" y="14" width="152" height="84" rx="14" class="f-g"></rect>
      <text x="438" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="h g">③ Dog body</text><text x="438" y="64" text-anchor="middle" class="s t2">the rest of Dog's</text><text x="438" y="82" text-anchor="middle" class="s t2">constructor runs</text>
      <path d="M160 56 H180" class="ln" marker-end="url(#inheritance-2-ar)"></path><path d="M338 56 H358" class="ln" marker-end="url(#inheritance-2-ar)"></path>
    </svg>
